event_summary.short: A woman jogging on Cloud Road was struck and killed by a pickup truck driven by 20-year-old Jacob Moore, who fled the scene. Moore's father, a Phoenix police lieutenant, alerted authorities. Moore later pleaded guilty to manslaughter and leaving the scene.
